Release notes for HC Studio version 2026.06.27.8:

- Agent Compatibility (Step 7): the DSPM + FDC section now also tells you whether the customer's DETECTED agent version is supported for each selected OS and Office product, not just whether the OS/Office is certified. Each row shows the matrix certification badge plus an 'AGENT OK' or 'UPGRADE → min vX' verdict comparing the deployed agent version against that row's minimum. Version-below cases are added to the findings, and the same verdicts appear in the exported report.
- (F1E already performed this OS/browser agent-version check.)

For more details, please refer to the official documentation or contact support.
